currentPriorities.title: Promotion History Ledger
currentPriorities.why: Promotion decisions should accumulate as a durable, queryable operating history.
currentPriorities.desiredOutcome: Append each Hermes promotion result into a promotion history ledger with status, score, reviewer, and linked artifacts.

currentPriorities.title: Multi-project Prioritization
currentPriorities.why: Sentra should choose between multiple active projects instead of only operating Hermes Mastra Lab.
currentPriorities.desiredOutcome: Rank active projects and generate promotion inputs from the highest-value project context.

currentPriorities.title: Weekly Review Feedback
currentPriorities.why: Weekly reviews should update priorities and stale risks instead of only reporting them.
currentPriorities.desiredOutcome: Convert review outcomes into proposed updates for sentra/priorities/current.json.

proposedPriorities.title: Promotion Ledger Multi-Source
proposedPriorities.why: The promotion history ledger only reads the single hardcoded hermes-promotion-v1.json artifact, so it would silently miss any future Hermes promotion workflow version.
proposedPriorities.desiredOutcome: Generalize the ledger writer to discover and append events from every Hermes promotion artifact, not just hermes-promotion-v1.json.

proposedPriorities.title: Operating Loop CI Coverage
proposedPriorities.why: CI only runs npm run check and npm run mastra:check, neither of which exercises the Sentra/Hermes promotion and ledger loop, so a regression there would go unnoticed.
proposedPriorities.desiredOutcome: Wire the Sentra/Hermes operating loop (context, promotion, ledger) into a script CI already runs.

proposedPriorities.title: Hermes Agentic Workflow Run Closeout
proposedPriorities.why: Multi-project prioritization selected Hermes Agentic Workflow as the top project, but its run-v4 PR lifecycle has been tracking-ready with no branch, push, or PR across multiple cycles, and no closeout artifact has been produced.
proposedPriorities.desiredOutcome: Produce the proposed post-merge ledger (or an explicit closeout decision) for run-v4 so the top-priority project stops stalling.

reviewSummary: Sentra generated operating context, Hermes consumed the promotion input, a promotion decision was produced, and the operating ledger linked the cycle artifacts.
notes: This proposes a priority rewrite from the weekly review.
It does not mutate sentra/priorities/current.json without approval.
